headline: Tadej Pogačar of Slovenia wins the 2026 Tour de France, his fifth victory in the race
summary: The route for the iconic cycling race's final stage was shortened because security and police were reassigned to assist with wildfires in southwest France.

headline: U.S. pauses attacks on Iran for a second straight day and Tehran does too
summary: The United States paused attacks on Iran for a second straight day Sunday and Tehran said it had done so too, as efforts continued to bring the countries back to negotiations on an interim ceasefire.

headline: Breakfasts around the world: Syrnyky, or curd-chees hotcakes in Ukraine
summary: Everyone in Ukraine has a story about syrnyki, the tangy, curd-cheese pancakes that have been a breakfast staple for hundreds of years.

headline: Lebanese displaced by war turn to satellites to check their homes
summary: Unable to return home, some Lebanese displaced by Israel's invasion of southern Lebanon are buying satellite images to see whether their houses survived.

headline: One dead, several injured after vehicle plows through crowd at Berlin Pride event
summary: Germany's interior minister Alexander Dobrindt described the incident as a likely "Islamic terror attack", and named the suspect as Abdul Ballout, who was born in Germany and has Lebanese roots.

headline: France and Spain fires force more than 300,000 to flee homes
summary: In France, around 50,000 people were evacuated from their homes overnight into Sunday, according to interior minister Laurent Nuñez. At least one person has died in a fire in Spain, officials said.

headline: India's 'cockroach' movement ousts minister, but can Modi calm youth?
summary: Led by Gen-Z youth across India, the movement has become perhaps the biggest challenge to Prime Minister Narendra Modi during his 12 years in office.

headline: Ukraine drone strikes on Wildberries warehouses hit Russian sellers, consumers
summary: Ukraine's attacks on warehouses of the Russian online retailer Wildberries have hurt small businesses and some consumers.

headline: The cooling crisis: How climate change forced air conditioning onto France's agenda
summary: For a country that's never needed -- and often looked down on -- air conditioning, this has been a summer of reckoning. As France suffers through successive extreme heatwaves, AC has become a political issue too.

headline: ICC member states vote to remove chief prosecutor Karim Khan
summary: The International Criminal Court voted to remove the global tribunal's chief prosecutor on Friday, nearly two years after sexual misconduct allegations against him first emerged, the court's oversight body announced.

headline: Regional leaders agree to new trade framework at summit
summary: Ministers from eight countries signed a preliminary framework easing tariffs on agricultural goods. Two governments abstained pending domestic review.
